_comment: Accepted dependency advisories. CI (scripts/check-audit.ts) fails on any high/critical advisory NOT listed here; moderate/low advisories never fail the build. Only add an entry after assessing impact â€” include the GHSA id, a concrete reason, and the date added. Remove entries once the dependency is upgraded (the gate flags stale entries). Policy: docs/3. architecture/dependency-management.md.

advisories.reason: tmp â€” dev-only, transitive via @lhci/cli (Lighthouse CI tooling); not part of any shipped artefact.

basic-ftp â€” quadratic-time DoS parsing FTP directory listings. Transitive via get-uri (proxy-agent -> pac-proxy-agent) for ftp:// PAC URLs; we never configure FTP proxies. Fix only exists in basic-ftp 6.x, which get-uri@6 (^5) does not accept. Dev-only: reached via @lhci/cli / puppeteer (Lighthouse CI). The workspace dev install puts it on disk in the backend image, but the server never imports it; it only runs in the CI Lighthouse job.

extract-zip â€” symlink path traversal on extraction. Used only by @puppeteer/browsers to unpack the Chrome build Lighthouse CI downloads from Google's CDN; never extracts user-supplied archives. No patched release published (2.0.1 is latest). Dev-only: reached via @lhci/cli / puppeteer (Lighthouse CI). The workspace dev install puts it on disk in the backend image, but the server never imports it; it only runs in the CI Lighthouse job.

extract-zip â€” arbitrary file write via symlink entries. Same exposure as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: only unpacks Lighthouse CI's Chrome download; no patched release published. Dev-only: reached via @lhci/cli / puppeteer (Lighthouse CI). The workspace dev install puts it on disk in the backend image, but the server never imports it; it only runs in the CI Lighthouse job.

zod — memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections; fixed only in zod 4.6.6+, and we are on zod 3.x across backend, frontend and shared (v4 is a breaking migration tracked separately). Exposure is bounded: Fastify's default 1MB bodyLimit caps request payload size before schema validation. Remove once zod is upgraded to v4.
